en.text: Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，与我相争的，求你与他们相争！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，與我相爭的，求你與他們相爭！

en.text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

zhSimplified.text: 拿着大小的盾牌，

zhTraditional.text: 拿着大小的盾牌，

en.text: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. my soul, “I am your salvation.”

zhSimplified.text: 抽出枪来，挡住那追赶我的；

zhTraditional.text: 抽出槍來，擋住那追趕我的；

en.text: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

zhSimplified.text: 愿那寻索我命的，蒙羞受辱！

zhTraditional.text: 願那尋索我命的，蒙羞受辱！

en.text: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们像风前的糠，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們像風前的糠，

en.text: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.

zhSimplified.text: 愿他们的道路又暗又滑，

zhTraditional.text: 願他們的道路又暗又滑，

en.text: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

zhSimplified.text: 因他们无故地为我暗设网罗，

zhTraditional.text: 因他們無故地為我暗設網羅，

en.text: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

zhSimplified.text: 愿灾祸忽然临到他身上！

zhTraditional.text: 願災禍忽然臨到他身上！

en.text: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心必靠耶和华快乐，

zhTraditional.text: 我的心必靠耶和華快樂，

en.text: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

zhSimplified.text: 我的骨头都要说：

zhTraditional.text: 我的骨頭都要說：

en.text: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

zhSimplified.text: 凶恶的见证人起来，

zhTraditional.text: 凶惡的見證人起來，

en.text: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

zhSimplified.text: 他们向我以恶报善，

zhTraditional.text: 他們向我以惡報善，

en.text: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

zhSimplified.text: 至于我，当他们有病的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 至於我，當他們有病的時候，

en.text: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

zhSimplified.text: 我这样行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄；

zhTraditional.text: 我這樣行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄；

en.text: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

zhSimplified.text: 我在患难中，他们却欢喜，大家聚集。

zhTraditional.text: 我在患難中，他們卻歡喜，大家聚集。

en.text: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

zhSimplified.text: 他们如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。

zhTraditional.text: 他們如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。

en.text: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，你看着不理要到几时呢？ 脱离少壮狮子！

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，你看着不理要到幾時呢？ 脫離少壯獅子！

en.text: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

zhSimplified.text: 我在大会中要称谢你，

zhTraditional.text: 我在大會中要稱謝你，

en.text: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 求你不容那无理与我为仇的向我夸耀！

zhTraditional.text: 求你不容那無理與我為仇的向我誇耀！

en.text: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他们不说和平话，

zhTraditional.text: 因為他們不說和平話，

en.text: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

zhSimplified.text: 他们大大张口攻击我，说：

zhTraditional.text: 他們大大張口攻擊我，說：

en.text: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你已经看见了，求你不要闭口！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你已經看見了，求你不要閉口！

en.text: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

zhSimplified.text: 我的 神我的主啊，求你奋兴醒起，

zhTraditional.text: 我的上帝我的主啊，求你奮興醒起，

en.text: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. let them gloat over me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—我的 神啊，求你按你的公义判断我，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－我的上帝啊，求你按你的公義判斷我，

en.text: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

zhSimplified.text: 不容他们心里说：阿哈，遂我们的心愿了！

zhTraditional.text: 不容他們心裏說：阿哈，遂我們的心願了！

en.text: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

zhSimplified.text: 愿那喜欢我遭难的一同抱愧蒙羞！

zhTraditional.text: 願那喜歡我遭難的一同抱愧蒙羞！

en.text: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

zhSimplified.text: 愿那喜悦我冤屈得伸的欢呼快乐；

zhTraditional.text: 願那喜悅我冤屈得伸的歡呼快樂；

en.text: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

zhSimplified.text: 我的舌头要终日论说你的公义，

zhTraditional.text: 我的舌頭要終日論說你的公義，
